0.name: model_name
0.description: The name of the pre-trained model to be used for training.

1.name: tokenizer_name
1.description: The name of the pre-trained tokenizer corresponding to the model.

2.name: num_train_epochs
2.description: Total number of epochs for which the model will be trained.

3.name: per_device_batch_size
3.description: Batch size per device during the training process.

4.name: model_class
4.description: Specifies the class of the model used for training.

5.name: tokenizer_class
5.description: Class of the tokenizer used along with the model.

6.name: device_map
6.description: Configuration for distributing the model across multiple devices during training.

7.name: precision
7.description: Precision setting for the training, affecting the model's performance and resource utilization.

8.name: quantization
8.description: Level of quantization to optimize the model size and inference speed.

9.name: lora_config
9.description: Configuration for PEFT LoRA optimization, example: `{"r": 16, "lora_alpha": 32, "lora_dropout": 0.05, "bias": "none", "task_type": "CAUSAL_LM"}`

10.name: use_accelerate
10.description: Flag to indicate the use of the 'accelerate' library for distributed training.

11.name: use_trl
11.description: Indicates whether TRL (Transformer Reparameterization Learning) is used for training.

12.name: accelerate_no_split_module_classes
12.description: Specifies module classes that should not be split during distributed training with 'accelerate'.

13.name: evaluate
13.description: Flag to determine if the model should be evaluated after training.

14.name: save_steps
14.description: Number of steps between saving checkpoints during training.

15.name: save_total_limit
15.description: Maximum number of checkpoints to keep; older ones are deleted.

16.name: load_best_model_at_end
16.description: Whether to load the best model based on evaluation at the end of training.

17.name: metric_for_best_model
17.description: The metric used to evaluate and compare models during training.

18.name: greater_is_better
18.description: Determines if a larger metric value indicates a better model.

19.name: use_huggingface_dataset
19.description: Flag to specify if a dataset from Hugging Face hub should be used.

20.name: map_data
20.description: Function to map and preprocess data before training.

21.name: hf_repo_id
21.description: Hugging Face repository ID for model storage and version control.

22.name: hf_commit_message
22.description: Commit message for Hugging Face repository updates.

23.name: hf_token
23.description: Hugging Face authentication token for accessing private repositories or pushing updates.

24.name: hf_private
24.description: Flag to determine if the Hugging Face repository should be private.

25.name: hf_create_pr
25.description: Indicates whether to create a pull request on the Hugging Face repository after pushing updates.

26.name: notification_email
26.description: Email address to send notifications about model serving status. Setting this allows for monitoring and alerting on model performance or downtime.

27.name: compile
27.description: Whether to just-in-time (JIT) compile the model before fine-tuning.

29.name: map_data
29.description: An arbitrary lambda function for custom changes to data, e.g. renaming fields: ```lambda d: {'label': d['intent'], 'text': d['utt']}```.
